name: Reka
short: Multimodal AI lab offering proprietary models (Reka Edge 2603 for vision/embodied AI, Reka Flash 3 for reasoning) plus curated open-weight models (GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen) on an OpenAI-compatible API, and a separate Vision API for video/image analysis with a free tier.

plans.name: Chat API pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Reka Edge 2603: $0.10 in / $0.10 out (16K ctx, text+image+video). Reka Flash 3: $0.10 in / $0.20 out (64K ctx, reasoning). Hosted open models: GLM 5.3 $1.17/$3.96 (1M ctx), DeepSeek V4 Flash $0.11/$0.66 (262K), Qwen 3.8 27B $0.20/$2.50, and others. Prompt caching at reduced rate on select models. No platform fee or markup.

plans.name: Vision API free tier
plans.notes: Free 3 hours (180 min) of video indexing, search and QA for evaluation. Beyond: $0.05/min video indexing, $0.005/search, $2 per 1M output tokens for QA/tagging, $0.04/min clip generation. Storage free (auto-delete after 30 days). Enterprise tier removes rate limits.
